messages:
Maya: Heads-up — after the kernel-selector change in staging, our deploy-time warmers saw a 25% drop in KV prefill hit-rate. Timeline: deploy 00:00, autoscaler burst 00:15, warmers run 00:20.
Eric: ugh. any obvious reason? kernel change affected KV key hashing?
Ben: I profiled a few cases. The new kernel packs attention differently and shifts chunk boundaries. That changed prefix normalization for longer prompts -> different cache keys.
Carla: can you paste the profile snippet?
Ben: ```
# pprof snippet
cpu profile: user 1m30s
hot funcs: prefix_normalize 32%, kv_key_hash 21%, batch_coalesce 18%
``` 
Maya: So warmer requests generated keys that don't match live requests because of subtle tokenization alignment differences.
Eric: That explains the hit-rate regression on deploy-time warmers specifically. Warmers use static truncated prompts; live requests vary slightly.
Carla: How did autoscaler events impact this? We saw spikes in miss rate during scale-up.
Ben: Autoscale spikes create many fresh workers with empty caches. Warmers run but use the older keying path until kernel selector flips in the worker. Timing mismatch.
Maya: ops-bot can you dump a sample of warmer vs live key pairs for model=redwood-7b:v2?
ops-bot: dump complete — 20 pairs saved to /tmp/warm-vs-live-2465.log
Eric: quick fix ideas: 1) normalize keying to token-level canonical form before hashing, 2) make warmers use live traffic sampling, 3) add a small post-deploy probe that runs with real-latency patterns.
Carla: prefer 1 + 3. Normalizing reduces future diffs, probe verifies end-to-end. Warmers fallback to sample-based seeding for edge cases.
Maya: also add jitter to scheduled jobs and randomize prompt truncation so we cover alignment permutations.
Ben: I'll open a patch: change kv_key_hash to use canonical_tokens = tokenizer.normalize(prefix) then hash(canonical_tokens). Minimal perf impact expected.
Ben: ```diff
- key = hash(prefix_bytes)
+ key = hash(tokenizer.normalize(prefix_tokens))
``` 
Eric: add unit tests for hash stability across kernels and an integration test that compares keys produced by kernel A vs kernel B.
Carla: we'll also add a metric: prefill.hit_rate_by_model_ver and prefill.key_mismatch_ratio.
Maya: timeline? We need a hotfix for next deploy (24h). Ben -> patch + unit tests today. Carla -> metrics & probe job tomorrow. Eric -> add integration test and schedule canary.
Ben: ACK. I'll post the PR link when ready.
Maya: thanks. If anyone sees large miss spikes in the next deploy, ping here and rollback recommended.
ops-bot: deploy event recorded: deploy/2465 -> kernel-selector v3.1
Maya: closing loop — will run a small synthetic A/B after patch to validate hit-rate returns to baseline.
